unauthenticated_api_rejection.behavior: Protected endpoints (/api/tasks, /api/tasks/<id>, /api/tasks/<id>/submit, /api/tasks/<id>/review, /api/audit-logs, /api/auth/users) return HTTP 401 with code AUTH_REQUIRED when token is missing or invalid.
unauthenticated_api_rejection.previous_vulnerability: Fallback to dummy USR-ANON (MANAGER role) in optional_auth decorator allowed unauthorized task mutations.
unauthenticated_api_rejection.remediation: Replaced optional_auth with require_auth decorator; removed all mock user fallback logic.

self_review_prevention.behavior: Manager cannot review or approve tasks where they are the assigned field worker.

estate_block_scoping.behavior: Queries and access checks enforce user estate_permissions and block_permissions.

task_visibility.rule: Workers can only view and query tasks explicitly assigned to their user ID (assigned_to_user_id == user.id).

task_submission.rule: Workers can only submit inspection findings for tasks assigned to them. Cross-assignment submissions rejected with HTTP 400/403.

review_denial.rule: Workers are strictly forbidden from reviewing or approving tasks (POST /api/tasks/<id>/review returns HTTP 403).

workflow_state_machine_integrity.valid_lifecycle: OPEN -> ASSIGNED -> IN_PROGRESS -> SUBMITTED -> COMPLETED / RETURNED

generic_patch_bypass_prevention.enforcement: PATCH /api/tasks/<id> explicitly rejects attempts to transition status directly to SUBMITTED, APPROVED, or COMPLETED (HTTP 400 with WORKFLOW_VIOLATION).
generic_patch_bypass_prevention.required_path: Formal submissions must use POST /api/tasks/<id>/submit; reviews must use POST /api/tasks/<id>/review.

demo_accounts_policy.behavior: Default demo accounts (admin@palmai.com, manager@palmai.com, worker@palmai.com) are set is_active=0 in production (PALM_AI_ENV=production or RENDER=true) unless PALM_AI_ENABLE_DEMO_ACCOUNTS=true is explicitly set in environment variables.

file_upload_and_inference_security.memory_protection: Images exceeding 2048x2048 are safely downscaled using Lanczos resampling to prevent OOM spikes on container runtimes.
file_upload_and_inference_security.path_traversal_protection: Files served via Flask send_from_directory with verified directory existence checks.
file_upload_and_inference_security.model_isolation: Inference runs read-only in memory; uploaded bytes never overwrite model weights or training datasets.
